items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s my cat, folks. She’s part of my history... I love animals.

ctx.x: You’re getting locked up for tomorrow! That’s my cat, folks. She’s part of my history, so what are you going to do. I love animals. Anyway I’m workin’ this gig somewhere and here comes a young saxophone player, 17, 18, whatever and he’s got his horn and he comes backstage and he said, “Can I talk to you?” And I said, “Sure, young man.” He said, “Are you the guy on that Billy Joel record?” I said, “Yes, I am.” He said, “Have you done anything on your own?” [chuckles] I said, “A couple things,” you know, Dizzy,…
